verdict.rationale: Firecrawl offers a natural-language 'search agent' mode ('Describe what you need... No URLs required') and lets users tune agent reasoning effort, which supports NL-driven operation, and its MCP/CLI integrations let AI agents invoke it conversationally through coding assistants. However, most of the product's core surface (scrape, crawl, extract, map) is still driven by structured API calls/schemas rather than free-form natural language commands. Missing for 10: evidence of full NL command coverage across all core endpoints (not just the search agent), and independent hands-on confirmation that NL commands reliably work end-to-end.
